name: Scotch Mutton Broth
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Rice or barley soaked in cold water
ingredients.originalText: Rice or barley soaked in cold water

instructions.text: Soak mutton in water for an hour
Cut off scrag, and put it in stewpan with three quarts of water
As soon as it boils, skim well, and then simmer for one and one-half hours
Cut best end of mutton into cutlets, dividing it with two bones in each
Take off nearly all fat before you put it into broth
Skim the moment the meat boils, and every ten minutes afterwards
Add carrots, turnips and onions, all cut into two or three pieces, then put them into soup soon enough to be thoroughly done
Let all stew together for three and one-half hours
About one-half hour before sending it to table, put in little chopped parsley and serve
Cut the meat off the scrag into small pieces, and send it to table in the tureen with the soup
The other half of the mutton should be served on a separate dish, with whole turnips boiled and laid round it

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Soak mutton in water for an hour
2. Cut off scrag, and put it in stewpan with three quarts of water
3. As soon as it boils, skim well, and then simmer for one and one-half hours
4. Cut best end of mutton into cutlets, dividing it with two bones in each
5. Take off nearly all fat before you put it into broth
6. Skim the moment the meat boils, and every ten minutes afterwards
7. Add carrots, turnips and onions, all cut into two or three pieces, then put them into soup soon enough to be thoroughly done
8. Stir in barley
9. Add salt to taste
10. Let all stew together for three and one-half hours
11. About one-half hour before sending it to table, put in little chopped parsley and serve
12. Cut the meat off the scrag into small pieces, and send it to table in the tureen with the soup
13. The other half of the mutton should be served on a separate dish, with whole turnips boiled and laid round it
